claims: The final space shuttle launch was mission STS-135.
Mission STS-135 featured the orbiter Atlantis.
Atlantis lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on July 8, 2011, at 11:29 a.m. EDT.
Mission STS-135 was commanded by Chris Ferguson.
The crew of mission STS-135 included Pilot Doug Hurley, Mission Specialists Sandra Magnus, and Rex Walheim.
Mission STS-135 launched from Launch Pad 39A, Kennedy Space Center.
The objective of mission STS-135 was to deliver the Raffaello multi-purpose logistics module with over 8,000 pounds of supplies and spare parts to the International Space Station.
Mission STS-135 marked the end of NASA's 30-year space shuttle program.
The Space Shuttle Program began with the first flight in April 1981.
Atlantis landed back at Kennedy Space Center on July 21, 2011.
